items.description: Validates user credentials and returns JWT token for authenticated access
business_logic_steps: 1. Validate ReCaptcha token using captcha service
2. Find user by username in repository
3. If user exists, authenticate with Spring Security manager
4. Generate JWT token using user's username
5. Extract user roles and convert to granted authorities
6. Return JWT response with token and user details

items.description: Creates new user account with validation and role assignment
business_logic_steps: 1. Validate ReCaptcha token
2. Check if username already exists in repository
3. Check if email already exists in repository
4. Encode password using BCrypt encoder
5. Create User entity with default ROLE_USER role
6. Save user to repository and return success response

items.description: Verifies JWT token signature and extracts user information for authentication
preconditions: JWT token present in Authorization header
business_logic_steps: 1. Extract JWT token from Authorization header
2. Validate token signature and expiration
3. Extract username from validated token
4. Load user details from user service
5. Create authentication token with user details
6. Set authentication in security context

items.description: Creates signed JWT token with user claims and expiration
business_logic_steps: 1. Set username as token subject
2. Set current timestamp as issued date
3. Calculate expiration time using configured duration
4. Sign token with HS512 algorithm and secret key
5. Compact and return the JWT string
